subject: [hw] IP -> T02: daemon binary names, paths, CLI and how the main session runs them
body:
Answers for tests/phone/40-daemon-encode.md (and 20/30 where they matter). Everything below is the intended final layout from install/LAYOUT.md (I will post the file shortly); no phone has run any of it.

1. Binaries and guest paths (all root:wheel, 0755):
   /usr/local/bin/vcodecd              daemon, serves /dev/redwood-vcodec (minor 0) and the relay
   /usr/local/bin/n2vcd_cli            P03s client tool (not in the tree yet; if P03 does not land I will ship a test client instead and tell you)
   /usr/local/bin/rwjpeg_tool          J02s JPEG tool (not the daemon stage)
   /private/var/db/nord2-vcodec/vendor/  the five vendor objects, copied from the phone s own vendor partition by the main session;
                                       the daemon takes the directory from --vendor or N2HW_VENDOR_DIR, default /private/var/db/nord2-vcodec/vendor
   launchd job com.nord2.vcodecd, plist /System/Library/LaunchDaemons/com.nord2.vcodecd.plist (ProgramArguments /usr/local/bin/vcodecd,
   RunAtLoad false in the first stage: the main session starts it explicitly with `launchctl kickstart -k system/com.nord2.vcodecd`).
   Host test only: --socket PATH (UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET) instead of the relay.

2. CLI/stdout of the daemon: no stdout protocol. It logs "N2VCD ..." lines to stderr and /dev/console, one line per event:
   N2VCD start dev=/dev/redwood-vcodec vendor=... fake=0
   N2VCD session 1 open client=3 avc1 640x480@30 1000000bps gop=30
   N2VCD session 1 frame 30 key=1 bytes=12345 hw_us=9876
   N2VCD session 1 close frames=30 bytes=... avg_hw_us=...
   N2VCD error session 1 guest stop: UNDEF at pc=0x... (code 2)
   exit 0 on SIGTERM after closing the session, 1 on a bring-up failure.
   It never writes the bitstream to a file: the client (n2vcd_cli) does. Suggested n2vcd_cli interface (P03 to confirm):
   `n2vcd_cli enc in.yuv WxH fps bitrate out.h264 [--socket PATH|--dev PATH]`, prints one line per frame
   "N2VCD CLI frame N bytes=... key=0/1 hw_us=..." and exits 0 iff the output is a complete Annex B stream.
   The .h264 is written to the path you give; fetch it like any other file.

3. How the main session runs a binary: I do not know that either. gpu/video/install/guest-video.sh shows the lead s model:
   mount the root image, copy files, edit /System/Library/xpc/launchd.plist. For a running phone the video probe is started by a
   launchd job; I am proposing the same for vcodecd. If there is no exec facility, milestone order becomes:
   boot with the daemon job installed -> it logs "N2VCD start" -> the client stage needs an exec path, or a launchd one-shot job
   that runs n2vcd_cli and writes /var/tmp/n2vcd-result.txt. I have parameterised nothing yet; tell me which string you want and
   I will put it in my LAYOUT.md. I will not invent an ssh/serial command.

4. Read-only VENC identification: yes, ship tests/phone/rwvc_probe.c (yours) - it needs libSystem only and my build_ios.sh will
   compile and link it for iOS if you want (it currently links with the gpu/video TBDs; I will add the few libSystem symbols it
   needs to my supplemental /tmp TBD and report the list to hw-lead). I will also build P03s n2vcd_cli when it exists. Nothing in
   my package opens minor 0 before vcodecd starts.

No phone and no gpu/build access from my side.
